defect.description: Input_args given as ordinary ffmpeg arguments in a string rather than a preset name (for example '-rtsp_transport tcp') are concatenated as a str onto the argument list: get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) + '-rtsp_transport tcp' raises TypeError (can only concatenate list to list), so audio detection fails to start; the fallbacks need get_ffmpeg_arg_list(...) like the global args.

review_items: src/audio.py:15-20 important: TypeError when input_args is a plain ffmpeg-arg string; fallback raw string concatenated to list
src/audio.py:14 pre-existing: IndexError when no input has audio role
src/audio.py:16 nit: magic 1 as detect_fps in audio context
tests/test_audio.py nit: no test for plain string input_args
votes.justification: The review pins down the defect exactly. A plain-string input_args is not a preset name, so parse_preset_input returns None and the raw string is concatenated onto a list in src/audio.py, which raises TypeError. It also flags the camera-wide fallback.
